speaker: alice
text: Alex, it is peak whale season out there and the humpback highway is absolutely chocka this year. Spotters along the coast are reporting some of the highest calf numbers in years, which is a ripper sign for the population bouncing back.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah I saw a clip of one breaching off the Gold Coast yesterday, closest thing to a proper miracle you will see before your morning coffee. Big tail slap, kids on the beach going off, the whole show.

speaker: alice
text: And closer to home, volunteers down on Moreton Bay just wrapped up a mangrove planting day that matched their best ever turnout. Hundreds of hands in the mud for a few hours, and thousands more little seedlings in the ground doing the hard yards for our coastline.
